forwardResponse.forceSharing: Equal force perturbation in each path; other muscle tensions held fixed.
forwardResponse.support: Right calcaneus pinned at the measured right center of pressure. Rotation around the point is free. Left foot is free.
forwardResponse.initialState: Three recorded midstance poses. Instantaneous rest at each assembled pose; output is the paired change in initial acceleration.
forwardResponse.units: degrees per second squared, in signed native OpenSim joint coordinates
forwardResponse.outcome: Change on removing 50 N of force, perturbed minus reference. This imposed differential force is a scenario, not a measured activation or an impairment severity.

summary.intervention: Both arms fixed at their stride-mean joint angles. Identical leg, trunk, pelvis and external force records.
